# The ground this run works over, and everything the last one left on the map.
#
# `_plan_touched` is the previous run's locations, which a new choice on the map
# may no longer contain -- a location dropped out of the candidates would else
# keep its buildings, in the map mode as much as in the window.
#
# **`bag_wtp_force_town` and `_force_rural` are not among the things removed**:
# they are the player's answer to «what is this location», not the plan's.
# Scope: country

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_passsw32 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_passpl32 value = 0 }

	# Every candidate made ready. **Every counter a `limit` reads has to exist
	# before the first round**: a comparison against a variable that is not there
	# is the failure that logs nothing.
	#
	# `_plan_seen` marks the province through its first candidate, so
	# `_plan_prov_locs` is one location per province -- what the row ordering
	# walks, and the only thing the plan still asks a province.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prank value = 9999 }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_goods
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_builds
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_touched target = this }
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_town_row value = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rooms add = bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_urban }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_towns add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_town_row
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rooms add = bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_rural }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_seen } }
			province_definition = {
				every_location_in_province_definition = {
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_seen value = 1 }
				}
			}
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs target = this }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_provn add = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# One scoring pass per good, the harvest that makes the answers comparable, and
# the count of how few places can hold it.
#
# **This is the expensive half of the mod and the reason the plan is a button of
# its own.** A single-good run reads about five methods on each candidate; this
# reads all 241 of them, 47 passes over the same ground.
# Scope: country

	bag_wtp_plan_harvest_47 = yes
}

# clay: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng1` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_1 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# The province decay counter, zeroed in this walk rather than in
		# `_plan_prepare` because this one happens anyway. **It has to exist
		# before the first round**: `bag_wtp_pdiv1` reads it on every
		# ordering, and a script value reading a variable that is not there is
		# the failure that logs nothing.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pp1 value = 0 }
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing the ground feeds: take the recipe it does not.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01. The
			# fallback is divided by 2 so that it is genuinely last in the
			# queue: everything the ground earns is placed before anything it does
			# not, which is «свести к минимуму» rather than forbid.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng1 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo1 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax1`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm1 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm1 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng1 add = 1 }
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:clay }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo1 add = 1 }
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng1 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm5 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr5 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm5 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr5 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p5 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm5 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr5 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm5 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm5 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p5 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm5 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p5 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm5 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr5 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm5 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr5 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng5 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo5 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax5`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm5 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm5 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng5 add = 1 }
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:fiber_crops }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo5 add = 1 }
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng5 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# fish: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng6` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_6 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# The province decay counter, zeroed in this walk rather than in
		# `_plan_prepare` because this one happens anyway. **It has to exist
		# before the first round**: `bag_wtp_pdiv6` reads it on every
		# ordering, and a script value reading a variable that is not there is
		# the failure that logs nothing.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pp6 value = 0 }
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing the ground feeds: take the recipe it does not.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01. The
			# fallback is divided by 2 so that it is genuinely last in the
			# queue: everything the ground earns is placed before anything it does
			# not, which is «свести к минимуму» rather than forbid.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm6 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p6 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm6 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr6 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm6 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p6 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm6 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr6 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng6 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo6 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax6`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm6 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm6 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng6 add = 1 }
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:fish }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo6 add = 1 }
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng6 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm9 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng9 add = 1 }
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:incense }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo9 add = 1 }
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng9 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# iron: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng10` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_10 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# The province decay counter, zeroed in this walk rather than in
		# `_plan_prepare` because this one happens anyway. **It has to exist
		# before the first round**: `bag_wtp_pdiv10` reads it on every
		# ordering, and a script value reading a variable that is not there is
		# the failure that logs nothing.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pp10 value = 0 }
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p10 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm10 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr10 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm10 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing the ground feeds: take the recipe it does not.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01. The
			# fallback is divided by 2 so that it is genuinely last in the
			# queue: everything the ground earns is placed before anything it does
			# not, which is «свести к минимуму» rather than forbid.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm10 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p10 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm10 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p10 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm10 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr10 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm10 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr10 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p10 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm10 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr10 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm10 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm10 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p10 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm10 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p10 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm10 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr10 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm10 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr10 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng10 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo10 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax10`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm10 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm10 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng10 add = 1 }
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:iron }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo10 add = 1 }
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng10 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr14 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm14 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing the ground feeds: take the recipe it does not.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01. The
			# fallback is divided by 2 so that it is genuinely last in the
			# queue: everything the ground earns is placed before anything it does
			# not, which is «свести к минимуму» rather than forbid.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm14 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p14 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm14 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p14 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm14 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr14 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm14 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr14 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm14 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p14 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm14 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr14 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng14 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo14 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax14`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm14 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm14 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng14 add = 1 }
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:medicaments }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo14 add = 1 }
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng14 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# salt: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng15` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_15 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# The province decay counter, zeroed in this walk rather than in
		# `_plan_prepare` because this one happens anyway. **It has to exist
		# before the first round**: `bag_wtp_pdiv15` reads it on every
		# ordering, and a script value reading a variable that is not there is
		# the failure that logs nothing.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pp15 value = 0 }
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p15 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm15 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr15 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm15 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing the ground feeds: take the recipe it does not.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01. The
			# fallback is divided by 2 so that it is genuinely last in the
			# queue: everything the ground earns is placed before anything it does
			# not, which is «свести к минимуму» rather than forbid.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm15 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p15 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm15 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p15 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm15 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr15 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm15 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr15 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p15 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm15 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr15 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm15 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm15 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p15 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm15 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p15 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm15 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr15 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm15 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr15 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng15 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo15 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax15`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm15 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm15 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng15 add = 1 }
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:salt }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo15 add = 1 }
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng15 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr18 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm18 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr18 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng18 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo18 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax18`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm18 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm18 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng18 add = 1 }
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:silk }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo18 add = 1 }
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng18 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# silver: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng19` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_19 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# The province decay counter, zeroed in this walk rather than in
		# `_plan_prepare` because this one happens anyway. **It has to exist
		# before the first round**: `bag_wtp_pdiv19` reads it on every
		# ordering, and a script value reading a variable that is not there is
		# the failure that logs nothing.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pp19 value = 0 }
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p19 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm19 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr19 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm19 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing the ground feeds: take the recipe it does not.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01. The
			# fallback is divided by 2 so that it is genuinely last in the
			# queue: everything the ground earns is placed before anything it does
			# not, which is «свести к минимуму» rather than forbid.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm19 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p19 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm19 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p19 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm19 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr19 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm19 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr19 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p19 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm19 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr19 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm19 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm19 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p19 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm19 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p19 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm19 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr19 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm19 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr19 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng19 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo19 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax19`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm19 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm19 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng19 add = 1 }
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:silver }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo19 add = 1 }
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng19 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for

# `_ng23` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the

bag_wtp_plan_harvest_23 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# The province decay counter, zeroed in this walk rather than in
		# `_plan_prepare` because this one happens anyway. **It has to exist
		# before the first round**: `bag_wtp_pdiv23` reads it on every
		# ordering, and a script value reading a variable that is not there is
		# the failure that logs nothing.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pp23 value = 0 }
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing the ground feeds: take the recipe it does not.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01. The
			# fallback is divided by 2 so that it is genuinely last in the
			# queue: everything the ground earns is placed before anything it does
			# not, which is «свести к минимуму» rather than forbid.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm23 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p23 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm23 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr23 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm23 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p23 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm23 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr23 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng23 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo23 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax23`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm23 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm23 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng23 add = 1 }
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:wild_game }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo23 add = 1 }
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng23 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# wine: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by

			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm27 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr27 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm27 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm27 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p27 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm27 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p27 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm27 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr27 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm27 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr27 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng27 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo27 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax27`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm27 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm27 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng27 add = 1 }
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng27 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# cannons: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng28` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_28 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# The province decay counter, zeroed in this walk rather than in
		# `_plan_prepare` because this one happens anyway. **It has to exist
		# before the first round**: `bag_wtp_pdiv28` reads it on every
		# ordering, and a script value reading a variable that is not there is
		# the failure that logs nothing.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pp28 value = 0 }
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p28 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm28 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr28 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm28 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing the ground feeds: take the recipe it does not.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01. The
			# fallback is divided by 2 so that it is genuinely last in the
			# queue: everything the ground earns is placed before anything it does
			# not, which is «свести к минимуму» rather than forbid.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm28 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p28 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm28 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p28 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm28 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr28 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm28 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr28 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm28 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p28 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm28 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr28 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng28 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo28 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax28`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm28 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm28 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng28 add = 1 }
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng28 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

		# ordering, and a script value reading a variable that is not there is
		# the failure that logs nothing.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pp32 value = 0 }
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing the ground feeds: take the recipe it does not.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01. The
			# fallback is divided by 2 so that it is genuinely last in the
			# queue: everything the ground earns is placed before anything it does
			# not, which is «свести к минимуму» rather than forbid.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm32 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p32 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm32 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr32 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm32 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p32 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm32 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr32 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng32 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo32 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax32`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm32 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm32 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng32 add = 1 }
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng32 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# glass: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng33` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.

	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng36 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo36 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax36`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm36 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm36 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng36 add = 1 }
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng36 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# liquor: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng37` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_37 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# The province decay counter, zeroed in this walk rather than in
		# `_plan_prepare` because this one happens anyway. **It has to exist
		# before the first round**: `bag_wtp_pdiv37` reads it on every
		# ordering, and a script value reading a variable that is not there is
		# the failure that logs nothing.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pp37 value = 0 }
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p37 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm37 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr37 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm37 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing the ground feeds: take the recipe it does not.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01. The
			# fallback is divided by 2 so that it is genuinely last in the
			# queue: everything the ground earns is placed before anything it does
			# not, which is «свести к минимуму» rather than forbid.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm37 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p37 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm37 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p37 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm37 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr37 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm37 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr37 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p37 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm37 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr37 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm37 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm37 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p37 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm37 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p37 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm37 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr37 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm37 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr37 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng37 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo37 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax37`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm37 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm37 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng37 add = 1 }
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng37 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01. The
			# fallback is divided by 2 so that it is genuinely last in the
			# queue: everything the ground earns is placed before anything it does
			# not, which is «свести к минимуму» rather than forbid.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm41 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p41 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm41 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p41 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm41 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr41 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm41 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr41 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm41 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p41 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm41 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr41 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng41 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo41 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax41`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm41 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm41 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng41 add = 1 }
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng41 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# pottery: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng42` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_42 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# The province decay counter, zeroed in this walk rather than in
		# `_plan_prepare` because this one happens anyway. **It has to exist
		# before the first round**: `bag_wtp_pdiv42` reads it on every
		# ordering, and a script value reading a variable that is not there is
		# the failure that logs nothing.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pp42 value = 0 }
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p42 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm42 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr42 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm42 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing the ground feeds: take the recipe it does not.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01. The
			# fallback is divided by 2 so that it is genuinely last in the
			# queue: everything the ground earns is placed before anything it does
			# not, which is «свести к минимуму» rather than forbid.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm42 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p42 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm42 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p42 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm42 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr42 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm42 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr42 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p42 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm42 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr42 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm42 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm42 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p42 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm42 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p42 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm42 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr42 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm42 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr42 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng42 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo42 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax42`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm42 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm42 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng42 add = 1 }
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng42 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng45 add = 1 }
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng45 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# tools: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng46` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_46 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# The province decay counter, zeroed in this walk rather than in
		# `_plan_prepare` because this one happens anyway. **It has to exist
		# before the first round**: `bag_wtp_pdiv46` reads it on every
		# ordering, and a script value reading a variable that is not there is
		# the failure that logs nothing.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pp46 value = 0 }
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p46 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm46 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr46 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm46 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing the ground feeds: take the recipe it does not.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01. The
			# fallback is divided by 2 so that it is genuinely last in the
			# queue: everything the ground earns is placed before anything it does
			# not, which is «свести к минимуму» rather than forbid.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm46 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p46 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm46 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p46 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm46 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr46 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm46 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr46 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p46 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm46 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr46 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm46 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm46 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p46 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm46 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p46 divide = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm46 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr46 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm46 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr46 divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng46 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo46 value = 0 }
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, which `bag_wtp_ordmax46`
	# does not do: it is the better of the two sides, so a good whose only
	# buildings are rural counts as makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm46 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm46 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng46 add = 1 }
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng46 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# weaponry: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for

# One good, into the location in hand.
#
# **Guarded, and asked the same question the ordered walk used as its `limit`**,
# so the urban-rights round can call this on its own without repeating a word --
# and so a right whose second good wants a building the first took is simply not
# given it.
#
# The building goes into a list beside the good, because that is what a location
# can only hold one of. Which building it is comes off the method the harvest
# kept.
# clay, town side.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_plan_try_town_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_can_town_1 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 39
			} }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:clay_pit }
			# Every location of the province, so the next building of this good
			# finds the whole province worth half. Guarded on the variable being
			# there: a province reaches locations that were never candidates.
			province_definition = {
				every_location_in_province_definition = {
					limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_pp1 }
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pp1 add = 1 }
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn1 add = 1 }
			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p1` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p1 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

			province_definition = {

					limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_pp4 }
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pp4 add = 1 }
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p4` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and

				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

# fiber_crops, town side.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_plan_try_town_5 = {
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_can_town_5 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm5 = 63
			} }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fiber_crops }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:fiber_crops_farm }
			# Every location of the province, so the next building of this good
			# finds the whole province worth half. Guarded on the variable being
			# there: a province reaches locations that were never candidates.
			province_definition = {
				every_location_in_province_definition = {
					limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_pp5 }
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pp5 add = 1 }
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn5 add = 1 }
			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p5` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p5 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p5 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm5 = 64
			} }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fiber_crops }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:shoen }
			# Every location of the province, so the next building of this good
			# finds the whole province worth half. Guarded on the variable being
			# there: a province reaches locations that were never candidates.
			province_definition = {
				every_location_in_province_definition = {
					limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_pp5 }
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pp5 add = 1 }
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn5 add = 1 }
			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p5` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
