# Urban rights, before any good is placed and only in towns.
#
# **A right is chosen per town, not by rights taking turns.** There are 12 of
# them and rarely that many towns in a plan, so an order over rights would decide
# the outcome by its own arbitrariness. Asked the other way round -- which right
# does this ground suit best -- every town gets the answer that is true about it.
#
# **And a right is granted whether or not the whole bundle fits**, since
# 2026-09-01: «Оно БУДЕТ выдано ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНО. И каждый такой город обязательно
# получит все здания из его бонуса.» The bundle's buildings go in before any
# ordinary good touches the town, and where the urban cap is smaller than the
# bundle the town simply runs out of room -- which is the thing the owner wants
# to see, at caps of 3, 4 and 5. Under the old all-or-nothing rule the
# thirty-fourth run granted one right across six towns.
#
# `bag_wtp_rq<k>` is the bundle's own normalized scores added up, which costs no
# pass -- the goods were scored anyway.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_place_rights = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
			var:bag_wtp_load = 0
		}
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 0 }
		# constantinopolitan_silk_monopoly_rights: cloth, fine_cloth, silk
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				bag_wtp_plan_right_fits_1 = yes
				scope:bag_wtp_country = { AND = { OR = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ has_or_had_tag = ROM } } }
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 1 }
		}
		# royal_artisan_rights: furniture, leather, pottery
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq2 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				bag_wtp_plan_right_fits_2 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 2 }
		}
		# royal_book_rights: books, dyes, paper
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq3 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				bag_wtp_plan_right_fits_3 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 3 }
		}
		# royal_brewing_rights: beer, liquor, wine
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq4 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				bag_wtp_plan_right_fits_4 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 4 }
		}
		# royal_jewelry_rights: jewelry
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq5 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				bag_wtp_plan_right_fits_5 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 5 }
		}
		# royal_masonry_rights: glass, masonry
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq6 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				bag_wtp_plan_right_fits_6 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 6 }
		}
		# royal_naval_rights: naval_supplies, tar
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq7 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				bag_wtp_plan_right_fits_7 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 7 }
		}
		# royal_textile_rights: cloth, dyes, fine_cloth
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq8 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				bag_wtp_plan_right_fits_8 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 8 }
		}
		# royal_tooling_rights: tools
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq9 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				bag_wtp_plan_right_fits_9 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 9 }
		}
		# royal_weaponry_rights: cannons, firearms, weaponry
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq10 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				bag_wtp_plan_right_fits_10 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 10 }
		}
		# scandinavian_bergslag_privileges: tools
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq11 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				bag_wtp_plan_right_fits_11 = yes
				scope:bag_wtp_country = { AND = { culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:scandinavian_group } } }
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 11 }
		}
		# scandinavian_tar_privileges: naval_supplies, tar
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq12 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				bag_wtp_plan_right_fits_12 = yes
				scope:bag_wtp_country = { AND = { culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:scandinavian_group } } }
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 12 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 1 }
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_29 = yes
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_30 = yes
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_18 = yes
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_right value = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven1 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 2 }
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_32 = yes
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_36 = yes
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_42 = yes
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_right value = 2 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven2 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 3 }
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_27 = yes
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_4 = yes
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_40 = yes
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_right value = 3 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven3 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 4 }
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_26 = yes
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_37 = yes
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_24 = yes
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_right value = 4 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven4 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 5 }
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_34 = yes
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_right value = 5 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven5 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 6 }
			if = {
				limit = { bag_wtp_plan_can_town_33 = yes }
				bag_wtp_plan_try_town_33 = yes
			}
			else = {
				# glass cannot stand here; plant the sand that would let it.
				bag_wtp_plan_try_town_17 = yes
			}
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_38 = yes
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_right value = 6 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven6 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 7 }
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_39 = yes
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_45 = yes
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_right value = 7 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven7 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 8 }
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_29 = yes
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_4 = yes
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_30 = yes
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_right value = 8 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven8 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 9 }
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_46 = yes
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_right value = 9 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven9 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 10 }
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_28 = yes
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_31 = yes
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_47 = yes
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_right value = 10 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven10 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 11 }
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_46 = yes
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_right value = 11 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven11 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 12 }
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_39 = yes
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_45 = yes
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_right value = 12 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven12 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn add = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# How many buildings each good may claim before the ground is opened to all.
#
# `_plan_rooms` is every candidate's cap added up and `_plan_placed` is what the
# rights have already spent, so the division is the fair share of what is left.
# `_plan_scored` is how many goods this ground can make at all -- a good nothing
# here can produce must not take a share and shrink everyone else's.
#
# **`max = 1` is the floor and it is deliberate.** A ground too small to give
# every good one building still gives every good one building; what gives way
# then is the cap, not the spread, and the header line says so by showing more
# goods than rooms. The RGO discount comes off the same number.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_set_quota = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_quota value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_rooms }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_quota subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_placed }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_quota max = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_scored > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_quota divide = bag_wtp_plan_scored_value }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_quota max = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pq1 value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_quota }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pq1 subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_nrgo1 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pq1 max = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pq2 value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_quota }

# The rounds, in tiers, the scarce goods first.
#
# **A good with one place in the whole ground that can hold it takes that place
# before a good with forty gets its second.** That is the owner's «жёстко
# зарезервировать слоты», and iron is the case he named: without an RGO it comes
# from one building, `bog_iron_smelter`, which wants wetlands or a lake, so where
# it can go at all it must. A tier admits only goods `_ng<n>` says few locations
# can host; the last tier is everything.
#
# Within a tier the sweeps run until one adds nothing anywhere, so **a location
# the plan can feed is never left empty**. The sweep counter is a guard against a
# condition that cannot be left, not a design.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_allocate = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_band value = 800 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_cover value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_tier value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_go value = 1 }
	# **The guard is per tier and not across them.** It was one counter for all
	# 6 of them for one load, and the thirty-third run spent it on the scarce
	# tiers: «кругов 12» on the screen, twenty-eight buildings out of a hundred
	# and forty-four places, most locations holding one thing. The last tier --
	# the one that fills the ground -- never ran at all.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_tsweeps value = 0 }
	while = {
		limit = {
			global_var:bag_wtp_plan_go = 1
			global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tsweeps < 12
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_tsweeps add = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_sweeps add = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added value = 0 }
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_1 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_2 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_3 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_4 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_5 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_6 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_7 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_8 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_9 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_10 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_11 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_12 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_13 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_14 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_15 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_16 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_17 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_18 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_19 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_20 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_21 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_22 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_23 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_24 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_25 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_26 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_27 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_28 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_29 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_30 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_31 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_32 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_33 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_34 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_35 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_36 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_37 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_38 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_39 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_40 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_41 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_42 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_43 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_44 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_45 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_46 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_47 = yes
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_added = 0 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_go value = 0 }
		}
	}
	# What this pass cost and what it had by the end of it. `_passsw` at
	# 12 is a pass the guard cut off with work still to do, which is the
	# one fault in here that leaves no other trace.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_passsw1 value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tsweeps }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_passpl1 value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_placed }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_band value = 800 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_cover value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_tier value = 2 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_go value = 1 }
	# **The guard is per tier and not across them.** It was one counter for all
	# 6 of them for one load, and the thirty-third run spent it on the scarce
	# tiers: «кругов 12» on the screen, twenty-eight buildings out of a hundred
	# and forty-four places, most locations holding one thing. The last tier --
	# the one that fills the ground -- never ran at all.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_tsweeps value = 0 }
	while = {
		limit = {
			global_var:bag_wtp_plan_go = 1
			global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tsweeps < 12
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_tsweeps add = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_sweeps add = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added value = 0 }
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_1 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_2 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_3 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_4 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_5 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_6 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_7 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_8 = yes

		bag_wtp_plan_pick_29 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_30 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_31 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_32 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_33 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_34 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_35 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_36 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_37 = yes

		bag_wtp_plan_pick_43 = yes

		bag_wtp_plan_pick_45 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_46 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_47 = yes
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_added = 0 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_go value = 0 }
		}
	}
	# What this pass cost and what it had by the end of it. `_passsw` at
	# 12 is a pass the guard cut off with work still to do, which is the
	# one fault in here that leaves no other trace.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_passsw32 value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tsweeps }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_passpl32 value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_placed }
}

# clay takes the one location each side of it suits best, or neither.
#
# `max = 1` on an ordered walk is the engine doing the choosing, which is the
# only reason a sweep over 47 goods twice is affordable. The tier gate above the
# walk is what holds a common good back while a scarce one is still placing.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_pick_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_ng1 <= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier
			}
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max
			}
			# The quota. **Never lifted** -- the open pass raises it by one a
			# round instead, so leftover ground fills in even layers rather than
			# going whole to whichever good the list happens to reach first.
			global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 < global_var:bag_wtp_pq1
			# The covering pass admits only a good that has nothing at all.
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cover = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 = 0
			}
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# **The band, and it is the whole of the optimum.** The ground is
			# dealt in descending order of gain across every good at once, so by
			# the time a good that would gain a tenth reaches a location, the good
			# that would have gained nine tenths has already taken it. That is the
			# opportunity cost, paid for by one comparison rather than by asking
			# every other good what it would have made of the place.
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_can_town_1 = yes
				bag_wtp_ord1 >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ord1
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_1 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_ng1 <= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier
			}
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max
			}
			# The quota. **Never lifted** -- the open pass raises it by one a
			# round instead, so leftover ground fills in even layers rather than
			# going whole to whichever good the list happens to reach first.
			global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 < global_var:bag_wtp_pq1
			# The covering pass admits only a good that has nothing at all.
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cover = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 = 0
			}
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# **The band, and it is the whole of the optimum.** The ground is
			# dealt in descending order of gain across every good at once, so by
			# the time a good that would gain a tenth reaches a location, the good
			# that would have gained nine tenths has already taken it. That is the
			# opportunity cost, paid for by one comparison rather than by asking
			# every other good what it would have made of the place.
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_can_rural_1 = yes
				bag_wtp_ordr1 >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ordr1
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			bag_wtp_plan_try_rural_1 = yes
		}
	}
}

			# the time a good that would gain a tenth reaches a location, the good
			# that would have gained nine tenths has already taken it. That is the
			# opportunity cost, paid for by one comparison rather than by asking
			# every other good what it would have made of the place.
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_can_town_8 = yes
				bag_wtp_ord8 >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ord8
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_8 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_ng8 <= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier
			}
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn8 < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max
			}
			# The quota. **Never lifted** -- the open pass raises it by one a
			# round instead, so leftover ground fills in even layers rather than
			# going whole to whichever good the list happens to reach first.
			global_var:bag_wtp_pn8 < global_var:bag_wtp_pq8
			# The covering pass admits only a good that has nothing at all.
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cover = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn8 = 0
			}
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# **The band, and it is the whole of the optimum.** The ground is
			# dealt in descending order of gain across every good at once, so by
			# the time a good that would gain a tenth reaches a location, the good
			# that would have gained nine tenths has already taken it. That is the
			# opportunity cost, paid for by one comparison rather than by asking
			# every other good what it would have made of the place.
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_can_rural_8 = yes
				bag_wtp_ordr8 >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ordr8
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			bag_wtp_plan_try_rural_8 = yes
		}
	}
}

				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_ng17 <= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier
			}
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn17 < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max
			}
			# The quota. **Never lifted** -- the open pass raises it by one a
			# round instead, so leftover ground fills in even layers rather than
			# going whole to whichever good the list happens to reach first.
			global_var:bag_wtp_pn17 < global_var:bag_wtp_pq17
			# The covering pass admits only a good that has nothing at all.
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cover = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn17 = 0
			}
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# **The band, and it is the whole of the optimum.** The ground is
			# dealt in descending order of gain across every good at once, so by
			# the time a good that would gain a tenth reaches a location, the good
			# that would have gained nine tenths has already taken it. That is the
			# opportunity cost, paid for by one comparison rather than by asking
			# every other good what it would have made of the place.
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_can_rural_17 = yes
				bag_wtp_ordr17 >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ordr17
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			bag_wtp_plan_try_rural_17 = yes
		}
	}
}

				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cover = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn26 = 0
			}
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# **The band, and it is the whole of the optimum.** The ground is
			# dealt in descending order of gain across every good at once, so by
			# the time a good that would gain a tenth reaches a location, the good
			# that would have gained nine tenths has already taken it. That is the
			# opportunity cost, paid for by one comparison rather than by asking
			# every other good what it would have made of the place.
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_can_town_26 = yes
				bag_wtp_ord26 >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ord26
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_26 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_ng26 <= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier
			}
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn26 < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max
			}
			# The quota. **Never lifted** -- the open pass raises it by one a
			# round instead, so leftover ground fills in even layers rather than
			# going whole to whichever good the list happens to reach first.
			global_var:bag_wtp_pn26 < global_var:bag_wtp_pq26
			# The covering pass admits only a good that has nothing at all.
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cover = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn26 = 0
			}
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# **The band, and it is the whole of the optimum.** The ground is
			# dealt in descending order of gain across every good at once, so by
			# the time a good that would gain a tenth reaches a location, the good
			# that would have gained nine tenths has already taken it. That is the
			# opportunity cost, paid for by one comparison rather than by asking
			# every other good what it would have made of the place.
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_can_rural_26 = yes
				bag_wtp_ordr26 >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ordr26
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			bag_wtp_plan_try_rural_26 = yes
		}
	}
}

				bag_wtp_ord35 >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band

# leather takes the one location each side of it suits best, or neither.
#
# `max = 1` on an ordered walk is the engine doing the choosing, which is the
# only reason a sweep over 47 goods twice is affordable. The tier gate above the
# walk is what holds a common good back while a scarce one is still placing.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_pick_36 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_ng36 <= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier
			}
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn36 < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max
			}
			# The quota. **Never lifted** -- the open pass raises it by one a
			# round instead, so leftover ground fills in even layers rather than
			# going whole to whichever good the list happens to reach first.
			global_var:bag_wtp_pn36 < global_var:bag_wtp_pq36
			# The covering pass admits only a good that has nothing at all.
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cover = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn36 = 0
			}
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# **The band, and it is the whole of the optimum.** The ground is
			# dealt in descending order of gain across every good at once, so by
			# the time a good that would gain a tenth reaches a location, the good
			# that would have gained nine tenths has already taken it. That is the
			# opportunity cost, paid for by one comparison rather than by asking
			# every other good what it would have made of the place.
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_can_town_36 = yes
				bag_wtp_ord36 >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ord36
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_36 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_ng36 <= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier
			}
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn36 < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max
			}
			# The quota. **Never lifted** -- the open pass raises it by one a
			# round instead, so leftover ground fills in even layers rather than
			# going whole to whichever good the list happens to reach first.
			global_var:bag_wtp_pn36 < global_var:bag_wtp_pq36
			# The covering pass admits only a good that has nothing at all.
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cover = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn36 = 0
			}
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# **The band, and it is the whole of the optimum.** The ground is
			# dealt in descending order of gain across every good at once, so by
			# the time a good that would gain a tenth reaches a location, the good
			# that would have gained nine tenths has already taken it. That is the
			# opportunity cost, paid for by one comparison rather than by asking
			# every other good what it would have made of the place.
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_can_rural_36 = yes
				bag_wtp_ordr36 >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ordr36
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			bag_wtp_plan_try_rural_36 = yes
		}
	}
}

				global_var:bag_wtp_pn44 < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max
			}
			# The quota. **Never lifted** -- the open pass raises it by one a
			# round instead, so leftover ground fills in even layers rather than
			# going whole to whichever good the list happens to reach first.
			global_var:bag_wtp_pn44 < global_var:bag_wtp_pq44
			# The covering pass admits only a good that has nothing at all.
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cover = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn44 = 0
			}
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# **The band, and it is the whole of the optimum.** The ground is
			# dealt in descending order of gain across every good at once, so by
			# the time a good that would gain a tenth reaches a location, the good
			# that would have gained nine tenths has already taken it. That is the
			# opportunity cost, paid for by one comparison rather than by asking
			# every other good what it would have made of the place.
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_can_town_44 = yes
				bag_wtp_ord44 >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ord44
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_44 = yes
		}
	}
}

# tar takes the one location each side of it suits best, or neither.
#
# `max = 1` on an ordered walk is the engine doing the choosing, which is the
# only reason a sweep over 47 goods twice is affordable. The tier gate above the
# walk is what holds a common good back while a scarce one is still placing.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_pick_45 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_ng45 <= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier
			}
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn45 < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max
			}
			# The quota. **Never lifted** -- the open pass raises it by one a
			# round instead, so leftover ground fills in even layers rather than
			# going whole to whichever good the list happens to reach first.
			global_var:bag_wtp_pn45 < global_var:bag_wtp_pq45
			# The covering pass admits only a good that has nothing at all.
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cover = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn45 = 0
			}
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# **The band, and it is the whole of the optimum.** The ground is
			# dealt in descending order of gain across every good at once, so by
			# the time a good that would gain a tenth reaches a location, the good
			# that would have gained nine tenths has already taken it. That is the
			# opportunity cost, paid for by one comparison rather than by asking
			# every other good what it would have made of the place.
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_can_town_45 = yes
				bag_wtp_ord45 >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ord45
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_45 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_ng45 <= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier
			}
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn45 < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max
			}
			# The quota. **Never lifted** -- the open pass raises it by one a
			# round instead, so leftover ground fills in even layers rather than
			# going whole to whichever good the list happens to reach first.
			global_var:bag_wtp_pn45 < global_var:bag_wtp_pq45
			# The covering pass admits only a good that has nothing at all.
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cover = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn45 = 0
			}
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# **The band, and it is the whole of the optimum.** The ground is
			# dealt in descending order of gain across every good at once, so by
			# the time a good that would gain a tenth reaches a location, the good
			# that would have gained nine tenths has already taken it. That is the
			# opportunity cost, paid for by one comparison rather than by asking
			# every other good what it would have made of the place.
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_can_rural_45 = yes
				bag_wtp_ordr45 >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ordr45
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			bag_wtp_plan_try_rural_45 = yes
		}
	}
}

# Scope: country

			max = 1

			bag_wtp_plan_try_rural_47 = yes
		}
	}
}

# The rows: one per location that got anything, its province's locations together.
#
# **Provinces are ranked first and their locations follow.** A sort on the
# location's own load ties nearly all of them and `ordered_in_global_list`
# promises nothing about ties, so two provinces would interleave. The provinces
# are put in order by how much the plan put in each, every location is told its
# province's place, and the rows sort on that with a province's towns ahead of
# its villages.
#
# A province's load is added up through a global, because a walk over its
# locations cannot write back to the scope that started it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_rank = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_count value = 0 }
		province_definition = {
			every_location_in_province_definition = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_load }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_count add = var:bag_wtp_load }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prov_load value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_count }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prov_n value = 0 }
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs
		order_by = bag_wtp_plan_prov_order
		max = 400
		check_range_bounds = no
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prov_n add = 1 }
		province_definition = {
			every_location_in_province_definition = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_prank }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prank value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_prov_n }
			}
		}
	}
	# Counted before the rows are taken and separately from them: the walk below
	# stops at 150, and a count that stopped with it would say the plan used
	# exactly as many locations as the window can draw, whatever it really used.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_found value = 0 }
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_load > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_found add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_shown value = 0 }
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_load > 0 }
		order_by = bag_wtp_plan_order
		max = 150
		check_range_bounds = no
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_shown add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rank value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_shown }
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_ranked target = this }
	}
}

# The window's own list, filled on opening and emptied on closing -- the same
# contract as the other two windows and for the same reason: a scripted widget
# never comes down, so emptying the datamodel is the only thing that frees a row.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_show = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_results
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_ranked
		order_by = bag_wtp_plan_rank_order
		max = bag_wtp_show_plan_shown
		check_range_bounds = no
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_results target = this }
	}
}

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_hide = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_results
}

# The same thing the window's own scripted GUI does, reachable from an effect,
# because a Mod Menu button is script and script cannot reach the interface's
# variable system.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_open_plan_window_effect = {
	bag_wtp_plan_show = yes
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_result_open
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_open
	bag_wtp_hide_results = yes
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_open value = 1 }
}
